title: Verify Tools Inside Container
description: Run three graded checks at the container prompt: promptfoo version, spacy NLP model, and opencode version.

steps.description: Three verification commands for required tools.
Promptfoo: promptfoo --version checks Node.js and promptfoo are wired correctly.
Spacy: python3 one-liner loads en_core_web_sm model and prints part-of-speech tag for a test sentence.
Opencode: opencode --version confirms the coding agent is baked into the image.
